title: Sales By Representative is visible to anyone who sees another Performance report
preconds:

2. You are signed in as that user..
steps: 1. Open the Reports navigation and read the Performance group.
expected:
1. "Sales By Representative" appears in the Performance group for this user — the entry is visible to every user who can see any other report in the same group.
